basic_details.job_title: SMFCL Chief Information Security Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Sagarmala Finance Corporation (SMFCL) has notified 1 vacancy for the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) post on a contract basis for a period of 2 years. Eligible candidates can apply by email by forwarding the application in the prescribed format along with a CV, proof of age, qualification, experience, last drawn pay details, and a recent passport-sized colour photograph to the designated address on or before 20 October 2026 till 6:00 PM Applicants must hold a full time Master's or Bachelor's Degree in engineering disciplines preferably Electronics & Telecommunications, Computer Scien

qualification.details: Educational Qualification: Full time Master's or Bachelor's Degree in engineering disciplines preferably Electronics & Telecommunications / Computer Science / Electronics & Electrical / Information Technology / Electronics & Communication or Master's in Computer Application (MCA). Candidates having certifications such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH), Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), or Certified Chief Information Security Officer (CCISO) shall be preferred. | Experience: Minimum 20 years of post-qualification experience out of which minimum 12 years experience in Information Security. | Age Limit: Maximum age as on cutoff date (23.09.2026) is 63 Years.

selection_process: The notification does not specify a multi-stage selection process other than shortlisting and review of applications.

content_sections.heading: SMFCL Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) at a Glance

rows.details: Master's or Bachelor's Degree in Engineering / MCA with experience

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Interested candidates must forward their application in the prescribed format (Annexure - 'A') along with a CV, proof of age, qualification, experience, and details of last drawn pay including level, grade and/or CTC (duly self-attested) with a recent passport-sized colour photograph to [email protected] on or before 20.10.2026 till 06:00 P.M.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Educational Qualification: Full time Master's or Bachelor's Degree in engineering disciplines preferably Electronics & Telecommunications / Computer Science / Electronics & Electrical / Information Technology / Electronics & Communication or Master's in Computer Application (MCA). Candidates having certifications such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH), Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), or Certified Chief Information Security Officer (CCISO) shall be preferred. Experience: Minimum 20 years of post-qualification experience out of which minimum 12 years experience in Information Security. Age Limit: Maximum age as on cutoff date (23.09.2026) is 63 Years.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Prescribed application format (Annexure - 'A') Curriculum Vitae (CV) Proof of age Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets Experience certificates Details of last drawn pay including level, grade, and/or CTC (duly self-attested) Recent passport-sized colour photograph

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notification does not specify a multi-stage selection process other than shortlisting and review of applications.

faq.question: Q1. Is the CISO post permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The engagement is on a contractual basis for a period of 2 years, which is further extendable based on performance and requirement.

faq.question: Q2. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age as on the cut-off date of 23.09.2026 is 63 years.

faq.question: Q3. What qualifications are preferred for the CISO position?
faq.answer: Candidates having certifications such as CISSP, CEH, CISA, CISM, or CCISO shall be preferred along with the essential engineering or MCA degree.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications by email is 20.10.2026 till 06:00 P.M.
